title: Button & Slider Interaction
description: Make clickable buttons and draggable sliders, and connect them to script logic.

slides.title: The Button Component 🔘
slides.content:
# Click and Respond

A **Button** is created by GameObject → UI → Button. It comes with a child Text and an Image background.

The Button component has an **OnClick** event list at the bottom. You can drag a GameObject with a script into the slot, and choose a public method to call when clicked.

You can also set navigation, transitions (color tint, sprite swap, animation), and interactability.

quizData.question: How do you assign a method to be called when a button is clicked?

options.text: Write the method name in a string field
Use the OnClick event list in the Button inspector
Attach a script with an OnClick() method automatically
Set the Button's Tag to the method name

quizData.explanation: The OnClick list in the Inspector allows you to wire up UnityEvents.

slides.title: The Slider Component 🎚️
slides.content:
# Draggable Value Selector

A **Slider** (GameObject → UI → Slider) provides a draggable handle. It has:
- **Min Value** / **Max Value** – range.
- **Value** – current value.
- **Whole Numbers** – restrict to integers.
- **On Value Changed** event – called whenever the slider moves.

You can style the background, fill area, and handle with Images.

Script access: `slider.value`.

quizData.question: How do you get notified when a slider's value changes?

options.text: Use the On Value Changed event in the Inspector or via script

quizData.explanation: The slider exposes an OnValueChanged UnityEvent that fires on change.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Toggle & Dropdown

Explore **Toggle** and **Dropdown** UI elements as well. They work similarly with OnValueChanged and OnClick events.
